summary: Trinity screams as the life-support monitors in the room suddenly jump back to life, indicating that Neo's vital signs have returned after being flatlined. Tank and Morpheus exchange a look of stunned realization, acknowledging the event as a miracle. Trinity immediately commands Neo to get up.

event_hint.one_line: Neo's vital signs return after a kiss, shocking the crew on the deck.

uncertain: Whether Neo is physically conscious or merely showing biological signs of life at this exact second.
